mechanism_narrative: A higher CPI (CPIAUCSL) indicates elevated inflation, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and higher real interest rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL is above the 75th percentile of its historical distribution (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary cycle, which increases the risk-free rate and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a low unemployment rate (UNRATE < 4.0%) and rising industrial production (INDPRO > 100.0) signals strong economic growth, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE < 4.0% AND INDPRO > 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When residential sales (RSAFS) exceed 700,000 million dollars, it indicates strong consumer demand, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS > 700000 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising labor force (PAYEMS) indicates strong job market conditions, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS is above its 50th percentile (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 310.0) signals a stagflationary environment, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 310.0 AND UNRATE > 4.0% (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1200) signals a contraction in the housing sector, which reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1200 (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
